Our interview process

Our people team is committed to respond to EVERY application.

People team interview

A conversation about career moves, motivations and skills.

Role-specific interview

Usually a call with the hiring manager, getting into the nitty gritty of the role and experience needed.

Task or presentation

Some roles may require a task or presentation at the third stage.

Culture interview

A conversation with someone in Tyk that works in a completely different area! This is to ensure we run a diverse and fair interview process.

ISO 9001 is a quality management
system standard that ensures
organizations meet customer and
regulatory requirements consistently.

ISO 27001 is a standard for
information security management
systems that helps organizations
protect their sensitive data.

PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry
Data Security Standard) is a
set of security standards designed
to ensure that all companies that
accept, process, store or transmit
card information maintain a secure
environment.

SOC2 is a standard for evaluating
the effectiveness of an organization’s
controls related to security,
availability, processing integrity,
confidentiality, and privacy.

Flexa is an accreditation for flexible
working companies

IMDA is a statutory board in
Singapore that seeks to drive the
country’s digital transformation and
adoption of technology.
